text:
emma: quick thread about a different take on sidebar IA + breadcrumbs. i'm leaning toward keeping canonical URLs clean and offering a 'snapshot view' button that creates a short server-side token for sharing exact UI state (open groups + pinned). figma: https://figma.com/file/snapshots-rail (frames). thoughts?
julio: interesting. server-side token avoids huge fragments and accidental PII in URLs. tradeoff = we need a tiny endpoint and TTL for tokens. fine for mvp?
nadia: accessibility caveat: whenever we restore a snapshot we must announce clearly and move focus to the restored target. SR users shouldn't be surprised by sections expanding. add an option to mute announcements for power users.
rick: engineering checklist: 1) snapshot payload = minimal ids + version hash; 2) store token with short TTL (e.g., 24h) and opt-out for sensitive teams; 3) when token present, server returns a 204 and client fetches state to replay UI. example flow in pseudo: 
```
POST /api/view-snapshot -> { token: "abcd" }
GET /nav?view=abcd -> returns state
```
emma: UX details: primary "Copy link" keeps canonical path. secondary action in kebab = "Copy exact snapshot" which creates token and copies /w/x/nav/teams/slug?view=abcd. show a subtle banner when loaded: "This link restores the UI state" with an action to strip snapshot.
julio: breadcrumb behaviour: breadcrumbs always use canonical paths. clicking a crumb expands the left rail to reveal the item and focuses it without changing the URL path. prefer focus then smooth scroll.
nadia: labels: use "Pin section" for strong action, and "Keep open" for helper text. for snapshot copy label: "Copy exact view (includes open sections)" and toast: "Exact view copied". include aria-live: "Restoring view" -> "Restored: Teams expanded".
rick: implementation note: while reconstructing, apply classes gradually to avoid layout thrash. use requestAnimationFrame and a small 120ms debounce when dealing with large lists so keyboard focus doesn't jump.
a11y-bot: checklist: role=button + tabindex=0 on headers, aria-expanded, aria-controls referencing list ID, pin button aria-pressed, live region with polite politeness for restore, keyboard shortcut to toggle pin (Shift+P). add tests for snapshot restore with NVDA/VoiceOver.
emma: decision suggestion: 1) canonical deep links via path segments; 2) ephemeral local state via history.state + sessionStorage; 3) explicit "Copy exact snapshot" uses server token for shareable exact view; 4) breadcrumbs expand+focus target but keep URL stable; 5) a11y announcements + mute option; 6) subtle banner when loading a snapshot with "remove snapshot state" action.
julio: +1, i'll prototype server token flow and TTL.
nadia: +1 from a11y, i'll add tests and the mute option to the spec.
rick: i'll draft the client utils for replaying snapshot state and the small API contract.
clipper-bot: preview created: rail-snapshots-proto -> staging at 2026-06-08T09:00Z (link: https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/rail-snapshots)
emma: thanks team 44d i'll update figma and post a short PR checklist here when ready.
